users.placeholderRow: Placeholder email. Edit it to a real address.

users.emailLogged: Done, but this server is in dev mode: no email was sent. The link is in the server console.
users.emailFailed: “{{username}}” still exists, but the email could not be sent.

reopen.title: Reopen this document?
reopen.description: {{name}} moves back to the Dashboard as unreviewed. Its reviewer and review note are cleared.

errors.generic: Something went wrong and the request did not complete. Please try again.
errors.notFoundOnServer: That document could not be found on the server.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your role does not allow this action.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE: Only PDF, DOCX and TXT files can be processed.
errors.EMPTY_DOCUMENT: No readable text — try a different file.
errors.EXTRACTION_FAILED: The document could not be read. You can try again.

errors.DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND: That document is no longer in the sheet — it may have been removed.

errors.WRONG_CURRENT_PASSWORD: Your current password is not correct.

errors.USER_PENDING: This user has not set a password yet. Use Resend invite instead.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.STORE_UNAVAILABLE: The user database is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
